| # | Date | Time · Room | Topic | Materials |
|---|------|-------------|-------|-----------|
| 1 | Mon 2 Nov | 17:00–19:00 · 202 | Statistical and AI foundations: hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, OLS, notions of prediction | — |
| 2 | Tue 3 Nov | 09:00–12:00 · 204 | Machine learning principles: bias–variance tradeoff, cross-validation | — |
| 3 | Mon 9 Nov | 17:00–19:00 · 202 | Advanced regression modelling: multiple and nonlinear regression | — |
| 4 | Fri 13 Nov | 09:00–12:00 · 204 | GLM extensions: logit, Poisson, survival models | — |
| 5 | Mon 16 Nov | 17:00–19:00 · 202 | Regularisation and high-dimensional methods: Ridge, LASSO, Elastic Net | — |
| 6 | Tue 17 Nov | 10:00–13:00 · 204 | Time series and forecasting: components, smoothing, trend and seasonality, AR and ARIMA, space–time models | — |
